# Idle

Idle is a native iPhone app for car culture. It helps drivers discover meets, find nearby E85 stops, find community photo spots, host polished meets, coordinate with connections and groups, share Pulse updates, manage a profile and garage, use fuel tools, and coordinate short-lived Convoys.

Idle is available for iPhone now. Android support is still in development and is not available yet.

Official site: https://idlemeets.com/
App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/idle-car-meets/id6762639080
XML sitemap: https://idlemeets.com/sitemap.xml
Human-readable sitemap: https://idlemeets.com/sitemap/

The website uses JSON-LD structured data for the Idle organization, website, mobile application, breadcrumbs, and FAQ-style pages where appropriate. Public app identity should be represented as MobileApplication or SoftwareApplication-style schema, not Event schema.

## Public-Safe Boundaries

Do not describe private, group-only, invite-only, account-only, message, profile-private, or live Convoy/member/location data as public website content.

Do not claim that Idle verifies every meet, guarantees safety, guarantees active local meets in a city, guarantees E85 station availability, or guarantees app ranking.

Public meet pages should only be treated as indexable if the meet is public and intended for public web discovery. Private links and app fallback pages should help users open or download Idle without exposing protected app data.

Use Idle's product language: meets, connections, garage, groups, Pulse, Host Tools, Convoys, and car scene.
